controles.affirmation: Le ministere de la Justice americain a depose le 14 janvier 2025 une plainte antitrust reprochant a KKR des declarations incompletes lors de notifications prealables a des fusions, et demande des penalites civiles ainsi que la possibilite d'une restitution de gains.
controles.verbatim_source: On January 14, 2025, the DOJ filed a civil antitrust complaint (the "DOJ Complaint") in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York against KKR and various KKR-sponsored investment entities alleging violations of the HSR Act. The DOJ Complaint requests various relief for the alleged violations of the HSR Act by the KKR Defendants, including civil penalties in an amount to be determined and various equitable relief, including potential disgorgement and injunctive relief against future violations of the HSR Act. (10-Q T2 2026, Regulatory Matters)

controles.affirmation: Un accord de reglement conclu en janvier 2025 sur le litige du Kentucky a ete refuse par le tribunal en mai 2025 et a donc pris fin, et la Cour supreme du Kentucky a entendu les plaidoiries le 17 juin 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: On January 8, 2025, KKR ... entered into an agreement with the Commonwealth of Kentucky ... to settle the 2020 AG Action and the 2024 AG Action. On May 12, 2025, the Kentucky trial court entered an order declining to enter the parties' jointly proposed order approving the settlement. Because the receipt of the court's approval was a contractual condition to the settlement becoming final, the settlement agreement terminated. ... The Kentucky Supreme Court heard oral arguments on June 17, 2026.

controles.affirmation: La direction ecrit ne pas etre en mesure d'estimer un montant ou une fourchette de pertes raisonnablement possibles, ce qui signifie qu'aucune provision ne couvre ces risques aujourd'hui.
controles.verbatim_source: KKR establishes an accrued liability for legal or regulatory proceedings only when those matters present loss contingencies that are both probable and reasonably estimable. ... Consequently, management is unable as of the date of filing of this report to estimate an amount or range of reasonably possible losses related to matters pending against KKR. In addition, any amounts accrued as loss contingencies or disclosed as reasonably possible losses may be, in part or in whole, subject to insurance or other payments
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer la deduction "ce qui signifie qu'aucune provision ne couvre ces risques aujourd'hui". Le document ne dit pas qu'aucune provision n'existe : il indique que KKR ne provisionne que ce qui est probable et estimable, et evoque explicitement des "amounts accrued as loss contingencies". Formulation correcte : "KKR ne provisionne que les litiges dont la perte est a la fois probable et chiffrable, et indique ne pas pouvoir estimer une fourchette de pertes raisonnablement possibles pour les affaires en cours."

controles.affirmation: Au quatrieme trimestre 2025, KKR a rembourse 344 M$ au titre du fonds Asian Fund II, ce qui a reduit son revenu de performance realise du semestre de 207 M$ nets.
controles.verbatim_source: Realized performance income in our Private Equity business line was reduced by $344 million as a result of the repayment of the Asian Fund II clawback obligation in the fourth quarter of 2025. On a net basis, after giving effect to carried interest distributions already recouped from current and former employees, the clawback obligation reduced fourth quarter 2025 net realized performance income by $207 million. (10-K exercice 2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer "du semestre" par "du quatrieme trimestre 2025". Le document rattache les 207 M$ nets au quatrieme trimestre 2025, pas a un semestre. Le montant brut de 344 M$ est exact.
